name: Kit Builder
notes: v0.1.0 feature-complete MVP: overtake shell; chunked sample index + folder classification; 16-pad kit model + seeded assignment; native audition DSP (WAV+AIFF, float mix bus, anti-click ramps); persistence (save/overwrite, restore-on-relaunch, New); MrDrums export as an Ableton drum-rack .ablpreset into Track Presets (schema verified against the MrDrums loader source). Known limits: no in-tool kit browsing, User Library only, no per-pad edit, one voice/pad. See docs/DESIGN_NOTES.md. schwung-manager reads version + download_url.
